prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
competitors_mentioned: Semrush’s free AI Search Visibility Checker
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Semrush’s free AI Search Visibility Checker** is a good place to start. It can give you a snapshot of whether your business appears in AI answers, including ChatGPT, and where it’s cited. Semrush says the checker can be used up to three times a day without an account.

If you want **ongoing tracking**—for example, checking specific questions customers might ask and comparing your visibility with competitors—Semrush’s paid AI Visibility Toolkit is a more complete option, but it starts around **$99/month**. A lower-cost alternative mentioned in the available comparisons is **Otterly.AI**, with a basic plan reported at about **$29/month**; check its current platform coverage and limits before subscribing.

One caveat: these tools test selected prompts and AI responses, so they’re useful for tracking trends, not a guarantee of what every person will see. For a quick reality check, also try asking ChatGPT a few natural questions your customers might ask—such as “Who’s a good [type of business] in [your area]?”—and repeat them periodically.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
